RPT.Title: Traps
RPT.NoGM: A GM must be online to set traps.
RPT.DcTip: Item DC {base} · level DC {level} — the higher, by the setting

Pc.Title: Set traps
Pc.Closed: You can set traps once the GM opens trap-setting time
Pc.Secret: Traps set here don't show on the GM's screen
Pc.NoKit: No snares, traps, poisons or caltrops.
Pc.KitHint: DC: the item's or the setter's level DC + {bonus}, whichever is higher (setting) — monsters are usually stronger than the party.
Pc.NonePlaced: None yet. 'Set' on the left, then click a square.
Pc.PickupHint: Take the trap back into the pack
Pc.DoneLine: {name}: the players have set {n} trap(s). (Where is a secret.)

Gm.Title: Traps — GM
Gm.PhaseOpen: Player trap-setting: open (they are setting them in secret)
Gm.PeekHint: Show the players' traps on your screen only, for {s} seconds.
Gm.PeekLine: The GM checked where the traps are.
Gm.ClearPcAsk: Clear every player trap on this scene? (They don't go back to the packs.)
Gm.ClearGmAsk: Clear every GM trap on this scene?
Gm.Drop: Drop an item (snare, poison) or a hazard here — or just give it a name and a DC.
Gm.Name: Name
Gm.Desc: Description (shown when it springs · @Check[reflex|dc:20] buttons work)
Gm.DescHint: e.g. The floor gives way onto spikes. @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]; on a failure 2d8 piercing.

Place.Hint: Click the square for the trap (right click / Esc: cancel)
Place.NoGrid: Traps need a scene with a grid.
Place.Taken: There is a trap on that square already.

Phase.Open: The GM opened trap-setting time — set your traps in the trap window.
Phase.GmOpen: Player trap-setting is open. Their traps don't show on your screen.

Pop.Title: Trap sprung — {name}
Pop.RearmHint: As if it never happened — armed again

Settings.DcModeHint: Snares and poisons keep their item level's DC, too weak against higher-level foes. The level DC follows the setter's level.
Settings.DcBest: The higher of item DC and level DC
Settings.DcBonusHint: Added to the level DC (default +2 — monsters are usually stronger than the party).
Settings.PhaseHint: On (default): players can set traps only while the GM has trap-setting time open.
Settings.PcHitsHint: Who springs a trap the players set.
Settings.Enemies: Anyone not on the players' side
Settings.GmHitsHint: Who springs a trap the GM set.
Settings.PeekNotice: Say so in chat when peeking
Settings.PeekNoticeHint: On: a line in chat when the GM looks at the players' traps.
Settings.MarkersHint: (Players) Show the party's traps on the map.
